top_headline: العنوان: القاهرة للدواجن (POUL.CA) دعوة الجمعية العامة غير العادية المقرر انعقادها في 30/11/2026 في تمام الساعة 03:00 مساءًاسم الشركة: القاهرة ل - معلومات مباشر
llm_summary:
- Cairo Poultry's stock has seen a significant decline, with a 38.3% drop in nine-month profit, as reported on November 16, 2026.
- The company's shares led the decline in the Egyptian stock market, with a 17% drop, causing it to top the list of most declining stocks.
- This decline in profit is despite a reported increase in consolidated revenue and standalone net income during the first nine months of 2026.
- On November 15, 2026, the Egyptian stock exchange announced the price limits for Cairo Poultry's stock, allowing a 35.19% decrease and setting a 27.09% temporary halt.
- The end of the right to receive a cash distribution for Cairo Poultry's shares was on November 15, 2026, with a coupon value of 1.89 Egyptian pounds per share.
- Cairo Poultry's shares experienced a sudden drop of more than 2%, leading the decline in the stock market, as of November 16, 2026.
- The company's profits for the first nine months of 2026 showed a 39% decline, with a drop in net profit to 1.44 billion Egyptian pounds, compared to 2.36 billion pounds in the same period of 2025.
- Despite the decline in profits, Cairo Poultry's revenues increased by approximately 1.1% to reach 12.1 billion Egyptian pounds during the first nine months of 2026.
